en.shortDescription: Ollama backend for the Continue IDE extension
en.longDescription:
Continue is an IDE extension; this template deploys Ollama as the recommended local backend.

Point Continue at ${SERVICE_URL_CONTINUE_DEV} with provider ollama. On first deploy, a one-shot init job pulls llama3.2.

de.longDescription:
